assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE premium tactical PC game HUD movement icon, square transparent PNG. A single full-body adult tactical operator in clean right-facing side profile, anatomically convincing proportions, small normal-sized helmeted head, compact plate carrier, fitted field trousers and combat boots. No weapon and no backpack. Art direction: beautifully balanced professional solid WHITE silhouette with elegant natural contour, broad simplified shape, readable at 32 pixels, like a carefully designed realistic military stance icon. Pure white visible pixels, opacity anti-aliasing only. No illustration shading, no gradients, no outline around silhouette, no black or colored parts, no textures or tiny seams, no cartoon, no rounded stick figure, no geometric joint circles, no exaggerated nose, no floating head. Exactly two anatomically correct arms, two legs. Full silhouette centered within safe margins, approximately 78 percent canvas height. No floor, shadows, labels, text, arrows, speed lines, frame or extra symbols. Truly transparent background. Pose: a relaxed purposeful WALK in a graceful natural long stride to the right. Head and torso nearly upright, small forward lean, leading leg extended forward with heel touching implied ground, trailing leg angled behind with heel lifted, natural counter-swing of relaxed arms, elbows slightly bent. Comfortable walking cadence, shoulders level, no crouching, no high knees, no tiptoeing, no bent front knee squat. Choose a convincing captured walking gait key pose with clear negative space between both legs and between arms and torso.
